title: Sam Pitroda says Indian youth care more about education and jobs than SIR protests

ai.summary: Sam Pitroda stated Indian youth prioritize education and jobs over SIR protests, contrasting with Rahul Gandhi's positive assessment of recent rallies.

facts.claim: Sam Pitroda highlighted that Indian youth are more focused on employment and education than the SIR issue
facts.quote: Sam Pitroda highlighted that Indian youth are more focused on employment and education than the SIR issue, explaining the limited momentum in anti-SIR protests compared to earlier student agitations like the NEET protests.

facts.claim: He contrasted these views with Rahul Gandhi’s positive assessment of recent rallies
facts.quote: He contrasted these views with Rahul Gandhi’s positive assessment of recent rallies, emphasising that young people prioritise jobs, quality education, and healthcare.
